name: Warehouse — Continuous Operations
tagline: Keep replenishing work moving without overfilling cargo.
narrative:
The 11×5 warehouse has two pick stations. Each station exposes another package as soon as the current one is collected.

The robot can carry only two packages. It must stop collecting when it is full, deliver the correct cargo, and then return for more work.
objective: Process all six station orders without exceeding the robot's two-package capacity.
learningObjective: Combine replenishing queues, finite capacity, and type-aware delivery in a continuous policy.
intelligenceExplanation:
The route is supplied, but no work rules are present. Pickup must require both `packageHere` and a free cargo slot.

Use separate red and blue delivery rules. The debug panel shows packages remaining and available cargo slots, so you can verify that the policy is making progress instead of repeatedly trying an impossible pickup.
hint: Guard pickup with `packageHere && capacityRemaining > 0`, then add typed delivery rules above navigation.
hints: Each station exposes its next package immediately after a pickup, but the robot has only two cargo slots.
A pickup rule should require both packageHere and capacityRemaining > 0.
Put typed red and blue delivery rules first, capacity-aware pickup next, and the supplied navigation rules last.
brief: Keep both replenishing stations moving while respecting two-package cargo capacity.
context: Six orders appear one at a time across two pick faces on a continuous aisle loop.

steps.label: Load work only while cargo space remains
Deliver orders from both station queues

goals.description: Deliver every order from both stations.

rules.description: Turn right at the end of an aisle.
